title: Greyhawk for 1e FRPG
description: The World of Greyhawk (1983 Guide and Glossography) and Greyhawk Adventures for 1e FRPG (Table Edition): deity clerics on the character sheet, a Greyhawk tab, the three books rewritten in plain words and arranged by topic, spells, magic items, monsters, avatars, personalities, encounter, birthplace and weather tables, a weather generator, and the Flanaess maps. An optional add-on; turn it on or off in Manage Modules. Built for a private table.
